provenance: Grok receipt supplied for research review; Grok sandbox execution was not independently observed.

findings.issue: No calibrated anchors for 0..1 indicator values
findings.research_proposal: Publish blinded annotation rubric and inter-rater agreement tests.

findings.issue: Unavailable input indefinitely blocks numerical score
findings.research_proposal: Keep score null; independently track verification-loss duration, requests, custodian, access remedies. Never infer guilt.

findings.issue: Source verification only checks nonempty strings
findings.research_proposal: Propose document identifier, retrieval date, content hash, verification status and audit receipt.

findings.issue: Not applicable and missing data both produce null
findings.research_proposal: Separate applicability ruling from missingness; test conditional renormalization, without adopting it yet.

findings.issue: No timeline for delays, transfers or repeated requests
findings.research_proposal: Use event log for requests, deadlines, responses, transfers and corrections.
